blurb: Guests cruise the St. Johns River aboard the historic Rivership Barbara-Lee, enjoying live entertainment and chef-prepared multi-course meals. The ship offers themed dining experiences including lunch, dinner, buffet nights, party cruises, and high tea. The Barbara-Lee is also available for private charters, weddings, and special events with climate-controlled comfort and scenic river views.
